title: How to Get a Barangay Clearance in the Philippines
description: Get your residency certification for employment, business, and other local government transactions.

requirements.title: Valid ID
requirements.description: A government-issued ID such as National ID, Passport, or Driver's License.

requirements.title: Proof of Residency
requirements.description: Utility bills, lease contracts, or homeowner certifications to verify your address.

requirements.title: Application Form
requirements.description: A completed form provided by the barangay hall.

checklist.title: Prepare Documents
checklist.description: Gather your valid ID and proof of residency before visiting the barangay hall.

checklist.title: Visit Barangay Hall
checklist.description: Proceed to your local barangay office during official working hours.

checklist.title: Fill Out Form
checklist.description: Provide accurate personal information and the purpose of your request on the application form.

checklist.title: Submit Requirements
checklist.description: Present your documents to the barangay personnel for verification and record checking.

checklist.title: Pay Fees
checklist.description: Pay the required clearance fee and keep the official receipt.

checklist.title: Claim Clearance
checklist.description: Receive your approved Barangay Clearance and verify that all information is correct.

blocks.content: A **Barangay Clearance** is an official document issued by the barangay government certifying that an individual is a resident of the barangay and has no known derogatory record or unresolved issue within the community.
It is one of the most commonly requested local government documents in the Philippines.
The document is often required for:
Barangay Clearances are issued by the barangay hall or barangay office where the applicant resides.

blocks.title: Is a Barangay Clearance the same as a Barangay Certificate?

blocks.content: Not always. Barangay Certificates may be issued for residency or other specific purposes, while Barangay Clearance generally includes community verification.

blocks.title: How long is a Barangay Clearance valid?

blocks.content: Validity periods vary depending on the requesting institution and barangay policies.

blocks.title: Can someone else apply on my behalf?

blocks.content: Some barangays may allow representatives provided authorization documents are submitted.
Yes, although some agencies may still request additional supporting documents.

blocks.title: Can students apply for Barangay Clearance?

blocks.content: Yes. Students commonly request Barangay Clearances for scholarships, school requirements, and employment applications.
Some barangays may require a Community Tax Certificate (Cedula) depending on local rules and application purpose.
